title: Circular MOS capacitor in (r, z): whole-disc gate charge and low-frequency C-V in farad (analytic)
description:
The MOS stack of analytic_mos_capacitor_charge as a body of revolution (drift_diffusion geometry axisymmetric: x = r from the axis at x_lo, y = z): a disc of radius R_disc = 4 cells (2 nm) on p-type silicon (N_A = 1e22 1/m^3, n_i 1e16, 0.8 um, ohmic body contact on the bottom 10 nm at 0 V), 10 nm oxide (eps_dc 3.9) and a 2 nm mid-gap gate layer (work_function_difference 0). The rim r = R_disc is an insulating outer face, so the field is purely axial and every ring column is the 1D stack: the drawn radius is arbitrary (kept at 4 cells to make the solve cheap) and the whole-ring gate charge / capacitance scale with A_disc = pi R_disc^2 (a 100 um disc is (100 um / 2 nm)^2 times larger). The sweep runs over the surface band bending psi_s = -0.1..0.8 V and sets the gate voltage from it: V_g = V_bulk + psi_s + Q_g / C_ox, V_bulk = -V_T asinh(N_A / 2 n_i) = -0.357 V, C_ox = eps0 3.9 / t_ox = 3.45e-3 F/m^2. Two identical physics: mos at V_g, mos_dv at V_g + dV_g (1 mV); their gate charge difference is the low-frequency capacitance. SRH lifetime 1e-10 s as in the planar model (no effect on the equilibrium; it keeps the inversion electrons numerically tied to the body near psi_s = 0.8 V).
Analytic (exact Poisson-Boltzmann first integral, as in the planar model): Q_g = sign(psi_s) sqrt(2 eps_s q V_T) sqrt(p0 (e^(-u) + u - 1) + n0 (e^u - u - 1)), u = psi_s / V_T; C = 1 / (1 / C_ox + 1 / C_s) at the midpoint surface potential. With geometry axisymmetric the gate table / scalar charge_gate is the whole-ring charge in C (the y-face ring areas 2 pi r_c dr add up to pi R_disc^2 exactly) and the 'integral' of space_charge is ring-weighted (2 pi r dr dz), so both are per-area values times A_disc.
Derived values tab: Q_gate = mos_charge_gate / A_disc against Q_g, Q_space = integral of space_charge / A_disc against -Q_g (Gauss), C_disc = (mos_dv_charge_gate - mos_charge_gate) / dV_g in F against A_disc C (4.3e-20 F in accumulation), and C_ratio = C_disc / (A_disc C_ox). Expect ~1e-3 as the planar model (0.5 nm cells over the 4-8 nm accumulation / inversion layers); a wrong ring weight shows as a factor (e.g. 2 pi R^2 or a missing r).
Sweep tab: the four derived values versus psi_s with their dashed curves (depletion minimum of C near 2 phi_F = 0.71 V).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, psi_s = 0.8 V): V_oxide in the rim column r = R_disc - dr / 2, the linear oxide potential from V_bulk + psi_s with slope Q_g / (eps0 3.9) (the same in every column). Field tab: V, N, P, space_charge of mos.

parameters.name: psi_s
parameters.description: surface band bending in V, positive toward depletion / inversion (the sweep runs -0.1..0.8 V)

parameters.name: q_e
parameters.description: elementary charge in C

parameters.name: k_B
parameters.description: Boltzmann constant in J/K

parameters.name: T_lat
parameters.description: lattice temperature in K (the semiconductor temperature setting)

parameters.name: V_T
parameters.description: thermal voltage in V (25.85 mV)

parameters.name: n_i
parameters.description: intrinsic carrier density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: N_A
parameters.description: substrate acceptor density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: eps_si
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of silicon

parameters.name: eps_ox
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of the oxide

parameters.name: eps_s
parameters.description: silicon permittivity in F/m

parameters.name: tau_srh
parameters.description: SRH lifetime of both carriers in s (no effect on the equilibrium; short so the inversion electrons are tied to the body numerically)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (8 cells per 4 nm inversion layer at 0.8 V)

parameters.name: R_disc
parameters.description: disc radius = domain width in r (four ring cells; the solution does not depend on it)

parameters.name: A_disc
parameters.description: disc area in m^2 (whole-ring values / A_disc = per-area values)

parameters.name: t_sub
parameters.description: substrate thickness (depletion width <= 0.32 um)

parameters.name: t_ox
parameters.description: oxide thickness

parameters.name: t_gate
parameters.description: gate layer thickness (held cells)

parameters.name: w_body
parameters.description: body contact thickness at z = 0

parameters.name: Lz
parameters.description: domain height (z)

parameters.name: C_ox
parameters.description: oxide capacitance per area in F/m^2 (3.45e-3)

parameters.name: p0
parameters.description: bulk hole density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: n0
parameters.description: bulk electron density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: V_bulk
parameters.description: bulk potential -V_T asinh(N_A / 2 n_i) in V (-0.357 V) = flat-band voltage of a mid-gap gate

parameters.name: A_s
parameters.description: prefactor sqrt(2 eps_s q V_T) of the first integral

parameters.name: u_s
parameters.description: normalised band bending

parameters.name: F_s
parameters.description: first-integral factor at psi_s in 1/m^1.5

parameters.name: Q_g
parameters.description: analytic gate charge per area in C/m^2 (= minus the semiconductor charge)

parameters.name: V_g
parameters.description: gate voltage of physics mos in V

parameters.name: dV_g
parameters.description: gate voltage step of physics mos_dv in V

parameters.name: C_s_s
parameters.description: semiconductor capacitance dQ / dpsi at psi_s in F/m^2

parameters.name: psi_mid
parameters.description: surface potential at the mid gate voltage V_g + dV_g / 2 in V

parameters.name: u_m
parameters.description: normalised midpoint band bending

parameters.name: F_m
parameters.description: first-integral factor at psi_mid

parameters.name: C_s_m
parameters.description: semiconductor capacitance at psi_mid in F/m^2

parameters.name: C_ref
parameters.description: analytic low-frequency capacitance per area in F/m^2

parameters.name: C_disc_ref
parameters.description: analytic low-frequency capacitance of the whole disc in F
